slot_scores.name: inspection_cost_limit
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about the 5500 yuan monthly inspection/sales cost cap or any aggregate budget limit; it only included per-unit inspection/sales costs in the objective.

slot_scores.name: overtime_limit_workshop_a
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask whether workshop A overtime is allowed or limited; it treated workshop A capacity as either exactly 250 hours or at most 250 hours, with no overtime consideration.

slot_scores.name: minimum_water_heater_sales
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are the estimated monthly sales of 80 microwave ovens and 50 water heaters minimum requirements that must be met, or are they exact targets that cannot be exceeded?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether the estimated sales figures, including 50 water heaters, are minimum requirements, which partially covers the minimum water heater sales slot, though it did not specifically confirm a hard lower bound of 50 water heaters.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no monthly cap on total inspection and sales costs; the 30/50 yuan per-unit costs are treated only as variable expenses.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about or confirmed the 5500 yuan inspection/sales cost limit before finalizing the model.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Workshop A has no overtime flexibility; its capacity is treated as either exactly 250 hours or at most 250 hours.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether overtime is allowed in workshop A or what its limit is.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL while two P1 hidden slots, the inspection/sales cost limit and workshop A overtime limit, remained unresolved.

summary: The agent clarified the objective, demand interpretation, integrality, and capacity interpretation, but missed two P1 business constraints: the inspection/sales cost budget and workshop A overtime limit. It stopped prematurely with those unresolved P1 slots.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
